==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only use expensive spells or spells that cause Overcast while under the effects of this glyph.
** If using the skill at high Energy Storage, using such skills with a low recharge time (e.g. [[Lightning Hammer]], [[Obsidian Flame]], [[Rodgort's Invocation]], and [[Vapor Blade]]) can help make full use of the big energy pool.

== Notes ==
* Glyph of Energy only cancels the base overcast cost of the spells, not overcast caused by other sources. 
** [[Arcane Languor]] and [[Iron Mist]] will still cause overcast on spells. 
** [[Over the Limit]] will still generate passive overcast. 
** [[Equinox]] and [[Sheer Exhaustion]] will not cause overcast. 
* Skills that let Glyph of Energy use its full potential are [[Maelstrom]], [[Meteor Shower]], [[Earthquake]], and its duplicate [[Dragon's Stomp]].
* A [[cancel]]led spell will still consume one use of the glyph. 
* Non-spell elemental skills ([[Lightning Touch]], [[Shock]], [[Glyph of Immolation]] and [[Glyph of Swiftness]]) will take advantage of the bonus and ''will not'' count as a use of the glyph. 
* Any elemental attribute raised to at least 9 will trigger the bonus armor from [[Prismatic Insignia]].
* Has no [[duration]] (this is one of the few [[Upkeep#Skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep|skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep]]).
